text:
maya (FinOps): FYI — spotted a $6,432.17 GPU charge this morning that is untagged and landed on account 'platform-prod'. digging in now. :eyes:

billing-bot: New invoice posted: INV-2026-03-23 total $6,432.17 (line: gpu-us-west1).

maya (FinOps): quick query I ran:```sql
SELECT COALESCE(team,'untagged') AS team, SUM(cost) AS cost
FROM cloud_billing_usage
WHERE service = 'gpu' AND usage_date = '2026-03-22'
GROUP BY team;
```
result CSV snippet:
```
team,cost
platform,6432.17
untagged,0.00
```

lee (Finance): @sam can you check whether this was really platform or a mis-tag? we need to reassign before the month close if wrong.

sam (Platform): looking now. 02:10-02:30 window shows heavy GPU usage from a shared pool used by the nightly indexer. logs show container image indexer:v3.2.1 deployed at 02:15.

sam (Platform): that indexer should be billed to Search team. deployment job didn't pass in the billing tag. suspect deploy script regression. @anna any idea?

anna (Search): yep that was our indexer rollout. we moved to sidecar-based workers last week. deploy pipeline had a param rename; forgot to add --billing-team. my bad.

maya (FinOps): OK — finance policy: reallocations <= $10k can be approved by finance with explicit owner confirmation + a ledger PR. @anna can you confirm you own this and approve reassign to team code 4005-search-research?

anna (Search): I confirm and approve reassign to GL 4005-search-research. I'll open JIRA BILL-4321 and add the invoice memo.

lee (Finance): good. maya, please create the ledger PR once JIRA is linked. we'll move charge and update month-end report.

maya (FinOps): will do. also going to backfill tags for the last 7 days for any indexer runs. sending a short CSV of candidate reallocations later today.

sam (Platform): quick mitigation: pushing a one-line fix to the deploy template to enforce billing tag. snippet:```bash
# ensure billing tag env is set
export BILLING_TEAM=${BILLING_TEAM:-search}
sed -i 's/--billing-team=""/--billing-team="$BILLING_TEAM"/' ci/deploy-indexer.sh
```
will rollout in next 10m.

mike (EngOps): can we also tighten the untagged GPU alert? current production threshold is $2k/day; this slipped under radar because it was a one-off near the threshold. propose lowering to $750 for prod pools and keep sandbox at $2k.

lee (Finance): agree for prod. lower to $750/day sounds reasonable. attach the new escalation: FinOps + owner pager on first alert.

maya (FinOps): @billing-bot can you create alert 'untagged_gpu_daily_v2' threshold $750 for tag-missing metric scoped to prod GPU pools?

billing-bot: Alert created: unlabeled_gpu_daily_v2; scope=prod-gpu-pools; threshold=$750/day; notify=[maya (FinOps), lee (Finance), oncall-eng].

sam (Platform): rolled out the deploy fix and added a unit test for the deploy template to fail when BILLING_TEAM is unset. CI green.

anna (Search): posted JIRA BILL-4321 with invoice reference and my approval. tagging the ticket with billing ledger PR tracking.

maya (FinOps): thanks all. I'll open the ledger PR, run backfill, and post the candidate reallocations CSV by EOD. if anyone sees similar unlabeled bursts please ping #eng-sre as well. :thumbsup:

lee (Finance): noted. closing loop here once ledger PR merges.

maya (FinOps): closing the thread — will update when PR done. :white_check_mark:
